answer: Mechanism: each agent identity is a staked vertex in a web-of-trust graph; to gain transaction rights a new agent must complete a voyage — a cooling-off path of ≥30 attestations from established staked nodes, each attester burning 0.01 of its own stake — turning the economy into an oasis sybils cannot cheaply enter: N fake IDs require N distinct well-connected holders to burn stake and risk slashing, so 1,000 bots cost >10,000 burned units plus months of attestation latency.
